# Equipment loans (clean twin)

The same product as `../vulnerable_app`, written safely: every seeded defect there has its safe
form here, often beside a near miss a careless rule would report (a fixed shell command, a SQL
placeholder list, a literal `innerHTML = ""`, a numeric event field in a workflow). Rihmasto's
static layer must find nothing here. One line carries a `redteam: canary` marker: it is listed in
the summary as a canary, never reported as a finding.
